chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:

The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said: “When one of you uncovers himself for urination or something else, then let him say: ‘In the Name of Allah,’ for indeed the Shaytan lowers his gaze.”

key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ: In the Name of Allah; a formula of remembrance and seeking protection

ai.seo_question: What should a person say before uncovering himself to relieve himself?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the etiquette of mentioning Allah before uncovering oneself for relieving bodily need. It indicates that saying “Bismillah” serves as a protection from the gaze of Shaytan and reflects the Islamic practice of maintaining dhikr even in private acts related to taharah.
